Rs 25.17 crores payable for acquiring 2,709 equity shares of Rs. 10 each, constituting 22.29% stake, of the Target Company from the existing shareholders of the Target Company for consideration other than cash has been settled by way of issue and allotment of 7,96,446 equity shares of the Holding Company having face value of Re 1/- each, at a price of Rs 316 per equity share (including a premium of Rs 315 (Rupees Three Hundred Fifteen only) per equity share to the existing shareholders of the Target Company.
